description: Seeds one open BTCUSDT position on the scenario it is named with: the position list holds a 0.001 long at 5x with a native stop-loss 300 ticks below its entry. The position-mode switch is refused with 110024, an existing position (the official v5 error table, #3005); the two margin-mode calls answer 110073, set margin mode failed, whose use for this refusal is unconfirmed. Closing orders are accepted by the scenario's order create; the fill, after which the list is flat, is state the stub transport keeps (#2893).

merge_patch.retMsg: You have an existing position, so the position mode cannot be switched.

POST /v5/position/switch-mode.note: No recording exists. 110024 and its message come from the official v5 error table (page dated 2026-10-14, #2893 S15; #3005): the open-position refusal of a position-mode switch, which mapping.py maps to an explicit, non-retryable rejection (never auto-switch mode). The message is the table's description, not a recorded reply.

POST /v5/position/switch-isolated.note: No recording exists. 110073, set margin mode failed, is the official v5 error table's margin-mode failure, which #2893 S15 advises for the margin-mode overlays. Whether the exchange answers a margin-mode switch with an open position this way is not verified, so the code stays flagged (README, unconfirmed codes).

POST /v5/account/set-margin-mode.note: No recording exists. 110073, set margin mode failed, is the official v5 error table's margin-mode failure, which #2893 S15 advises for the margin-mode overlays. Whether the exchange answers a margin-mode switch with an open position this way is not verified, so the code stays flagged (README, unconfirmed codes).

expected.outcome: The account holds one BTCUSDT position at 5x whose native SL stays on the exchange throughout (C-2.6); while it is open, a margin-mode switch is refused with 409 conflict (TC-420).
